verdict.rationale: three.js is itself a documented programmatic API: code creates a scene, camera and mesh, adds objects to the scene and configures the renderer (threejs-gh-4, threejs-gh-1). Agents drive the library directly through npm, guided by llms.txt and llms-full.txt files written for LLMs (threejs-probe-rt-2). However, the three.js editor (threejs-docs-7) has no evidenced scripting or automation interface, there is no MCP or OpenAPI surface (threejs-probe-3), and nothing shows build triggering. Missing for 10: a documented scriptable interface for driving the editor, programmatic build/export triggering, and an agent-facing control surface beyond the raw library API.
